title: The Archive of Sector Nine
author: U. M. Lockridge
blurb: Rosalind Vasquez, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
